summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py, which handles all eight depot formats and the shared export conventions (gzip, BOM/charset, directives, mid-file headers, per-row units, fixed-width layouts by length, corrections/voids/resends, handovers). I ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/summary.json, and tools/check_summary.py reports every value matching the reference.
